entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. How can I assist you today?
Yeah, hi. I ordered a VeloBand Pulse like, a week ago and it's already busted. I want a refund. This is ridiculous!
I understand your frustration, and I apologize for the inconvenience this has caused. Could you please provide your order number so I can look into this for you?

Thank you. One moment, please. Okay, I see your order here. It was placed eight days ago. Regarding returns, the policy is, oh, wait actually, let me correct myself. I said 'regarding returns' but for defective items, you're looking at a replacement. The return window is for undamaged, unwanted items.
A replacement? Are you kidding me? I don't want another one of these pieces of junk! I want my money back!

I understand your concern. Allow me to check the return window for defective devices. The return period, I misspoke. For the Pulse it's actually 10 days. You are eligible for a replacement within 10 days of purchase. Let me correct myself, I meant for a *full refund* within 10 days. My apologies. I apologize for the confusion.
So you're telling me I *can* get a refund? Because I'm not waiting for another one of these things to break after a week. This is costing me money because I can't track my fitness properly.

Yes, that is correct. Given that it's only been eight days, and you're experiencing a defect, you are absolutely eligible for a full refund. I apologize for the initial miscommunication. To initiate the refund process, I need to confirm your shipping address. Is it still located at 123 Main Street, Anytown, USA?
Yes, that's it. Finally! This has been a nightmare.

Okay, great. I have processed the refund. You should see the amount credited back to your account within 5-7 business days. Once again, I sincerely apologize for the trouble you experienced with the VeloBand Pulse and the initial confusion regarding the return policy.
Okay, well, thanks. I appreciate you finally sorting it out. I was ready to explode.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for contacting VeloFit customer support. Have a great day!
